sources.title: GLM 5.3 Flash API & Playground | Fireworks AI
sources.snippet: GLM-5.3-Flash is the first natively multimodal model in the GLM-5 series with 320B total parameters and 18B active parameters. It incorporates several architectural improvements over GLM-5.2 including a hybrid architecture, sharply reducing long-context serving costs while preserving precise long-context and Manifold-Constrained Hyper-Connections (mHC) to further improve scaling efficiency.
